name: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC)
solves: Open exchange of BIM lifecycle data across authoring and FM tools
adoption: High as exchange standard; implementation quality varies
jcxImplication: Require IFC 4.3 deliverables with model-view and property validation
caveat: Valid IFC may still omit operational properties or lose relationships

name: Information Delivery Specification (IDS)
solves: Machine-readable information requirements and automated IFC validation
adoption: Final standard; growing tool ecosystem
jcxImplication: Attach IDS to every design procurement construction and handover gate
caveat: Validates declared model content not physical truth; poor requirements remain valid

name: BIM Collaboration Format (BCF)
solves: Portable model issue and clash coordination without proprietary model files
adoption: High; file and web implementations
jcxImplication: Make issues first-class records linked to IFC GUIDs and evidence
caveat: Issue layer is not full document/change control; test API versus file support

name: buildingSMART Data Dictionary (bSDD)
solves: Stable multilingual classes properties values and relations for built environment terms
adoption: Live service; dictionary quality/governance varies
license: Free service with terms/licensing by publisher
jcxImplication: Use URIs and versioned API mappings plus JCX Bangladesh extension
caveat: Content/API versions change; cache terms and never rely on unversioned identifier URLs

name: open Common Data Environment APIs
solves: Cross-platform document issue and data-environment exchange
adoption: Emerging/openBIM API ecosystem
jcxImplication: Require API export/import and document/issue archive from CDE vendors
caveat: Vendor CDE may claim compatibility without full round-trip semantics

name: ISO 19650 information management
solves: Defines information requirements roles workflows approvals status and security across asset lifecycle
adoption: High process maturity in BIM-led markets
jcxImplication: Create OIR AIR PIR EIR BEP CDE status and responsibility matrix
caveat: Certification can become paperwork unless linked to decisions and tests

name: ISO 19650-5 security-minded BIM
solves: Sensitivity triage and security-minded management of sensitive information
adoption: Published and confirmed; adoption depends on contracts
jcxImplication: Classify and restrict security drawings tenant data and critical-system information
caveat: Does not replace ISO 27001/OT controls or local law

name: ISO 23386 property dictionary methodology
solves: Rules roles and governance for properties in interconnected data dictionaries
adoption: Published methodology; requires local governance
jcxImplication: Run a JCX dictionary commission with definitions units mappings and versions
caveat: Defines method not content; governance effort remains with JCX

name: ISO 23387 data templates
solves: Machine-interpretable object data templates across asset lifecycle
adoption: Published 2025; aligned with ISO 12006-3; XSD available
jcxImplication: Template equipment products spaces handover and environmental data
caveat: Templates require actual domain content and product data adoption

name: OSCRE Industry Data Model
statusOrVersion: 130+ use cases public description; current home references 150+
solves: Common enterprise real-estate investment occupier lease vocabulary and schemas
adoption: Industry-led and broad; full IDM requires registration/license
jcxImplication: Map leases units parties investments procurement and portfolio data to OSCRE
caveat: Do not force enterprise model into IFC geometry; access and version terms apply

name: ISO 55000 asset management
solves: Value-aligned lifecycle asset-management vocabulary principles outcomes and maturity
adoption: Published; mature management-system family
jcxImplication: Connect asset condition risk lifecycle cost service level and sustainability to decisions
caveat: Framework does not itself provide a software schema

name: ISO 55001 asset management system
solves: Requirements for an asset-management system and continual improvement
adoption: Published; certification ecosystem
jcxImplication: Use as governance target for lifecycle maintenance and capital planning
caveat: Certification costs and process overhead; not a digital-twin model

name: ISO 41001 facility management
solves: FM management-system requirements and service alignment
adoption: Published; international FM standard
jcxImplication: Link work orders services SLAs occupants and asset outcomes
caveat: Management system not a point/telemetry ontology

name: Brick Schema
solves: Semantic graph of building assets systems spaces equipment points and relationships
adoption: Open-source; strong smart-building and research ecosystem
jcxImplication: Evaluate as canonical operations graph for cross-building analytics
caveat: Modeling effort and ontology crosswalks required; not enterprise lease/BIM model

name: Project Haystack
solves: Pragmatic tags file types ontology and HTTP API for building IoT data
adoption: Established building-automation ecosystem; flexible but ambiguous
jcxImplication: Ingest Haystack and normalize to JCX with tag/profile validation
caveat: Tag ambiguity and vendor profiles can impair automated reasoning

name: RealEstateCore
statusOrVersion: Public repository; REC v5 branch updated 2026
solves: Modular ontology for property ownership inhabitants technical systems sensors and events
adoption: Open community ontology; not ISO or universal contract
jcxImplication: Use as candidate crosswalk between property and operations concepts
caveat: Pin version and test implementations; avoid mixing REC versions

name: Digital Twins Definition Language
statusOrVersion: DTDL v2/v3 supported by Azure Digital Twins
solves: JSON-LD model language for twin interfaces properties components and relations
adoption: Product/runtime mature; cloud-specific semantics
jcxImplication: Use as a projection with neutral JSON-LD/JSON Schema/RDF export
caveat: Cloud/runtime lock-in and version migration; not neutral property system

name: BACnet building automation protocol
solves: Vendor-independent building automation communication for HVAC lighting access elevators security and fire
adoption: Very high; widely implemented; BTL certification
license: International/open protocol standard; product certification separate
jcxImplication: Require BACnet/IP or BACnet/SC gateway and BTL evidence where practical
caveat: Protocol interoperability does not guarantee semantic point mapping or cyber safety

name: Modbus
solves: Simple device/register communication and TLS/X509 security option
adoption: Very high legacy footprint; simple semantics
license: Published specification with organization license terms
jcxImplication: Use segmented read-only gateway and persist register maps scaling units and quality
caveat: No native semantics; legacy serial and unsafe internet exposure are risks

name: Matter
solves: IPv6 application-layer interoperability for smart-home devices
adoption: Emerging consumer ecosystem; not commercial BMS replacement
license: Alliance specification with member reproduction terms
jcxImplication: Use selectively for resident devices with commissioning and offboarding
caveat: Version/device-category support and consumer lifecycle; not HVAC/fire/elevator standard

name: OGC API Features
solves: Feature-level REST/OpenAPI access to parcels buildings roads permits and amenities
adoption: Approved open standard; modern API family
jcxImplication: Use for spatial search/query and partner exchange preserving CRS
caveat: Core read scope and implementation parts differ; test CRS/filter/write behavior

name: OGC SensorThings API
solves: Unified geospatial Web API for sensor observations metadata and tasking
adoption: Approved open standard; specialized ecosystem
jcxImplication: Expose interoperable sensor observations when useful and preserve quality/time
caveat: High-volume time series and control authorization need separate architecture

name: OGC CityGML/CityJSON
solves: 3D city-model exchange for planning BIM navigation disaster energy and urban twins
adoption: Approved standard; adoption varies by city/data maturity
jcxImplication: Link district context and parcels to IFC building/project IDs
caveat: 3D geometry complexity and version/encoding conversion can lose semantics

name: W3C PROV-O/PROV-DM
solves: Interoperable model for entities activities agents and derivation of data
adoption: Stable Web standard; implementation is application-dependent
jcxImplication: Attach source document hash extraction method reviewer and supersession to every claim/measure
caveat: Provenance does not prove truth; capture evidence and validation separately

name: GHG Protocol Corporate and Scope 3
solves: Boundaries and categories for corporate/value-chain GHG inventories
adoption: Very high global reporting adoption; methodology evolves
jcxImplication: Store activity data factor source period boundary estimation and assurance
caveat: Scope boundary choices can double count; not a property data model

name: RICS Whole Life Carbon Assessment
solves: Consistent embodied operational and user carbon assessment and deviation reporting
adoption: Professional standard; strong quantity-surveyor/ecosystem use
jcxImplication: Link BIM quantities EPDs procurement operations maintenance and end-of-life
caveat: Area basis boundaries factors and deviations must be aligned before comparing

name: CRREM Pathways and Risk Assessment
solves: Country/property pathways for energy/carbon intensity and misalignment year
adoption: Strong investor/ESG use; 44+ countries; methodology under review
license: Open access data with licensing for commercial redistribution
jcxImplication: Version pathway factors occupancy area and assumptions in every result
caveat: Pathways update; primarily operational/in-use and not embodied carbon

name: GRESB Real Estate Assessment
solves: Investor-driven benchmark for management performance development and sustainability evidence
adoption: High investor adoption; annual self-reporting and validation; methodology changes
jcxImplication: Store raw evidence and project GRESB as reporting projection
caveat: Score is not canonical data or proof of technical performance; weights evolve

name: WiredScore/SmartScore
solves: External certification of digital connectivity and smart-building capability
adoption: Market certification ecosystem; criteria can change
jcxImplication: Store certificate scheme version scope date evidence and expiry
caveat: Certification not network topology, data quality or cyber assurance

name: ISO/IEC 27001 information security
solves: Confidentiality integrity availability risk management and ISMS controls
adoption: Very high global certification/assurance maturity
jcxImplication: Use for corporate/CDE/cloud supplier controls and audit evidence
caveat: Certification does not guarantee OT safety or correct implementation

name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
solves: Govern Identify Protect Detect Respond Recover governance and risk profiles
adoption: High practical adoption; voluntary and adaptable
jcxImplication: Create current/target profiles for IT CDE BMS/OT and vendors
caveat: Framework is outcome-oriented; map controls to actual implementation

name: IEC 62443 industrial automation security
statusOrVersion: Current series; verify part/edition for procurement
solves: OT zones systems components and supplier security requirements
adoption: Established industrial/OT framework; part-specific
jcxImplication: Use for BMS/PLC gateway segmentation and vendor responsibilities
caveat: Choose exact parts and security levels; do not claim compliance generically

name: ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system
solves: Organization-wide AI policies risk transparency accountability and continual improvement
adoption: First international AI management-system standard; growing ecosystem
jcxImplication: Create AI inventory risk classification impact assessment logs and human oversight
caveat: Management certification is not model accuracy or fairness proof

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
solves: Voluntary trustworthy AI risk management across design/deploy/use/evaluation
adoption: High practical ecosystem; voluntary and living
jcxImplication: Use for tenant screening maintenance analytics worker/camera and GenAI release gates
caveat: Current framework revision means pin version and record mappings

name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
solves: Risk-based legal obligations for AI placed on/used in EU market
adoption: Binding EU law; extraterritorial relevance depends on service/data
jcxImplication: Use as a high-bar reference for EU customers/data and sensitive decisions
caveat: Legal applicability is fact-specific; obtain counsel and track implementing rules

name: ISO 14001 environmental management
solves: Environmental management system and continual improvement
adoption: Very high global management-system maturity
jcxImplication: Connect environmental objectives evidence corrective actions and operational data
caveat: EMS certification is not a carbon calculation or building-performance guarantee

name: Bangladesh Personal Data Protection Ordinance
solves: National privacy/data-protection obligations and rights
adoption: Current Bangladesh legal watchlist; counsel required
jcxImplication: Minimize identity data separate marketing/tenant/visitor/CCTV and define retention/access
caveat: Legal status and implementing rules can change; do not treat summary as legal advice

name: Bangladesh National Data Governance Ordinance
solves: National data governance interoperability lifecycle transparency and accountability
adoption: Current Bangladesh legal watchlist; counsel required
jcxImplication: Use data inventory provenance classification stewardship and interoperable exports
caveat: Confirm applicability/authority and amendments before implementation

name: Bangladesh National Digital Architecture standards
solves: Guidance for data architecture Unicode DBMS GIS GML catalogue and KML
adoption: Relevant government interoperability baseline; not a property-specific schema
jcxImplication: Support Unicode Bangla/English OGC GIS and practical DB/API exports
caveat: Public-sector requirements may not map directly to private developer; verify latest edition
